editions.fonte_scan: scripts/scan_day.py - 24 posts na janela; TheBlock__ e Superstate vazios (quarto dia seguido)

replies.pt: Anthropic ($ANT) cai 6% no premarket num selloff de IA, com Nvidia e AMD em queda (CNBC, via UW).
replies.a: a 6% premarket gap next to nvidia red is just monday with extra steps
replies.b: the shares gap at 09:30. ANTx had the whole night to find a price, and did it without a bell
replies.c: every AI selloff now has a premarket edition. that's the tell

replies.pt: Ouro despenca abaixo de US$ 3.550 — maior tracao do dia, 7,5 mil likes.
replies.a: gold dumping at 2am is the original all-night market tbh
replies.b: a 2am crash is only a crash if you can trade it. depth decides headline or fill
replies.c: 'safe haven' and 'down' in the same headline is doing a lot of heavy lifting

replies.pt: Musk: a IA da Tesla, no computador AI4, chega agora ao Torment II no Diablo — 7,6 mil likes, 1.029 replies.
replies.a: the car can beat diablo but it still can't find parking downtown
replies.b: agents don't sleep. neither should the venue they trade on
replies.c: a machine that grinds demons for fun will absolutely outlast you on a 3am chart

replies.pt: Mantle: Bending Spoons (Vimeo, Evernote, WeTransfer) reporta antes da abertura e o $BSPx da xStocks negocia 24/7.
replies.a: four apps i stopped opening years ago and one ticker i now check at 3am
replies.b: reporting before the open is a scheduling choice. access is whether a fill exists after it
replies.c: bullish on evernote trauma being a portfolio thesis

replies.pt: xStocks: $ANTx passa a negociar no Zerion — a acao tokenizada da Anthropic distribuida pelas chains que o usuario ja usa.
replies.a: claude got a ticker before i got a decent night of sleep. fair i guess
replies.b: distribution is the growth story: one asset, many frontends, one venue doing the execution
replies.c: every new listing makes the 'no access' crowd quieter, and i'm here for it

posts.text:
one tokenized anthropic share.
zerion this morning, ether.fi before that.
distribution is the boring word for 'you can actually reach it'

anthropic shares dropped 6% before the bell.
the tokenized version doesn't wait for a bell to have a price.
a gap is just a price nobody could argue with for a few hours

bending spoons reports before the open today.
vimeo, evernote, wetransfer - one balance sheet, three apps you forgot you had.
the shares wait for 09:30. the token doesn't

memes.caption: the ai beat diablo before it learned to merge at a yield sign
memes.cena: Fluxion mascot slumped on a beanbag with a controller, headset on, visor glowing red at a boss fight on a floating screen, empty energy cans around and a candlestick chart faintly reflected in the nebula belly.

memes.caption: gold at 3am: the safe haven meets the one guy who never sleeps
memes.cena: Fluxion mascot in a dark kitchen lit only by phone glow, tail flame turned down low, visor showing one red gold candle, cereal bowl untouched, wall clock reading 3:00.

editions.notas_pt: A xStocks publicou tres vezes sobre o $ANTx (Ether.fi 08:54Z, 'Claude made no mistakes' 07:47Z e Zerion 10:08Z) e a Anthropic aparece caindo 6% no premarket na UW: o dia gira em torno do mesmo ativo em dois angulos. A WatcherGuru entrou pela primeira vez desde a liberacao - ouro abaixo de US$ 3.550, 7,5 mil likes, maior alcance do dia. Angulo (b) variado de proposito (gap vs preco sem sino, profundidade no crash das 2h, agentes que nao dormem, execucao depois do report, distribuicao). Nenhum numero fora da fonte primaria. Logs de 19/11 dos tres reporteros continuam ausentes.

modal_card.regra: Toda edicao nova do Clarim vai ao Hadukem em UM modal clicavel: link do post em cima de cada item, letras a/b/c em lista uma por linha, opcao 'nenhuma' e campo de porque por item, um unico botao de envio no fim.

watcherguru.regra: Nao existe denylist de conta; o filtro e por post (janela de 12h, assunto proprio, numero com fonte).
